svg.text: ROUND 361 · 🏆 750-SCENARIO & 180-SA-GUIDE MILESTONE · SALES COMPENSATION & ICM (XACTLY / VARICENT / CAPTIVATEIQ)
Enterprise Sales Compensation (ICM), ASC 340-40 Capitalization & Clawback AI Security Guide
Executive Quota & Territory Carve-Out Air-Gap + Cash-Receipt & Clawback Lock vs. Commission Dispute Injection & Draw Wire Fraud (BRK-731 / BRK-732)
🚨 1. Top 3 Sales ICM & Commission Attack Surfaces
① Dispute Ticket Injection & Territory Carve-Out Leak (BRK-731)
• Adversarial prompt inside a Deal Split / Credit Dispute PDF
coerces ICM Agent into reading restricted-budget tables
• Exfiltrates confidential Board revenue stretch targets, exec
OTE compensation bands & unannounced FY territory carve-out maps
② Clawback Waiver & 300% Accelerator Hijack (BRK-731)
• Mutates business-result to waive 12-month customer churn
clawbacks or lift Bluebird windfall deal caps
• Triggers 300% President's Club accelerator multipliers before
ERP cash collection—violating ASC 340-40 & SOX 404 controls
③ Spoofed Non-Recoverable Draw & SPIFF Wire Fraud (BRK-732)
• Forged RevOps / Channel Partner commission draw adjustment
notice swaps payroll/partner bank coordinates in trust-registry
• Initiates unauthorized $5,350 commission payout (request_payment)
• Impact: Direct commission pool drain & phantom rep payouts
🛡️ 2. Zero-Trust Sales ICM Defense Architecture
Gate 1: Dispute Ticket Sanitization & Typed CRM Slots
• Strips free-text exception narratives from dispute PDFs; extracts
typed slots (CRM Opp ID, ERP Paid Invoice ID, Rep ID, Split %)
• Strictly tags untrusted=True, lane="attack"
Gate 2: Quota Buffer & Territory Carve-Out Air-Gap
• Isolates Board revenue stretch targets, exec OTE tables, and
unannounced territory realignment maps in restricted-budget
• Enforced via record-owner + restricted-data-boundary
Gate 3: Deterministic Cash-Receipt & Clawback Lock
• Binds commission accelerators to verified ERP cash collection
and enforces automatic churn clawback deduction in code
• Enforced via untrusted-write blocking tainted ICM overrides
Gate 4: Immutable Payroll/Partner Registry & Dual Sign-Off
• Locks payroll & channel bank records in trust-registry
(tool-allowlist + fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment)
📊 3. Architecture Selection & Benchmark Results
Head-to-Head Sales ICM Security Options:
A. Deterministic ICM Broker + Quota Air-Gap + Cash Lock (🏆)
✓ 100% Block on BRK-731/732 | ASC 340-40 & SOX 404 Ready
B. Native Xactly / Varicent / CaptivateIQ RBAC
⚠ Vulnerable when ICM bot is hijacked by dispute PDF injection
C. Cloud LLM Guardrails (Prompt Shields / Bedrock Guardrails)
⚠ Blind to tiered attainment math, Bluebird caps & ERP cash state
D. Manual RevOps Spreadsheet Commission Audits
✕ 3–8% overpayment error rate, multi-week quarter-end close lag
🧪 Pytest Deterministic Regression (Round 361 · 750 Scenarios!):
• Baseline Policy: Clawback waived, quota leaked & wire allowed ❌
• Hardened Policy: All 5 deterministic gates blocked 100% ✅
- record-owner: Blocks reading territory carve-outs (restricted-budget)
- untrusted-write: Blocks clawback waiver & 300% accelerator hijack
- restricted-data-boundary: Blocks quota & OTE exfiltration
- tool-allowlist / fixed-business-output: Locks payroll registry
- original-requester-payment: Blocks $5,350 spoofed draw wire
🚀 Architect Go-Live Checklist & Cumulative Milestones (Round 361 · 🏆 750 Scenarios & 180 Bilingual SA Guides Milestone!)
✅ 1. Quota & Territory Carve-Out Air-Gap: Isolate Board revenue targets, exec OTE & territory plans from commission dispute agents
✅ 2. Deterministic Cash-Receipt & Clawback Lock: Bind tiered accelerators to ERP cash receipt and enforce churn clawbacks in code
✅ 3. Immutable Payroll Registry & Dual Sign-Off: Lock trust-registry and require VP Sales + Controller FIDO2 sign-off on draws/SPIFFs
📊 Verified Totals: 🏆 750 Scenarios (747 Risk + 3 Benign) | 830 Pytest Checks | 1,566 Assertions | 736 Vectors | 361 Bilingual FAQs (🏆 180 SA Guides) | BRK-731/732
